Game Overview

Feed The Fox is a animal title where navigate a delightful world as you guide a hungry fox in a dash to catch plummeting chicks while artfully dodging bombs. Test your reflexes and decision-making in this charming challenge where patience and strategy are key to survival. Can you keep the fox fed and safe?
